title: Member Services Standard — Closure of a Kestrel Care Rewards Membership
content:
A **Kestrel Care Rewards** membership closes in one of three ways: at the patient's own request, through inactivity at a free level, or when a suspended membership is not reinstated within its window.

## Standard

**C1 — Closure at the patient's request.** A membership is closed at the patient's own request, which the patient confirms themselves. Closing forfeits every unconverted point and all unused Kestrel Cash.

**C2 — When a Plus cancellation takes effect.** A Plus cancellation takes effect as the level provides: at the end of the paid cycle, or the same day. Refunds of Plus fees follow the Plus membership refund rules.

**C3 — Inactivity at a free level.** A free membership with no activity of any kind for the level's inactivity-closure period in calendar months closes, where that period is above 0.

**C4 — Suspended and not reinstated.** A suspended membership that is not reinstated within its window closes.

## Closure terms by level

| Level | When a Plus cancellation takes effect | Inactivity-closure period (calendar months without any activity) |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Member | not applicable | 24 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | not applicable | 24 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | not applicable | 24 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | not applicable | 24 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly | at the end of the paid cycle | 0 (no inactivity closure) |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual | immediately, the same day | 0 (no inactivity closure) |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical memberships)

| Membership | Event | Outcome under the standard |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver, active, 3400 unconverted points and 6.00 of unused Kestrel Cash | the patient asks to close and confirms the closure themselves | the membership closes; the 3400 points and the 6.00 of Kestrel Cash are forfeited |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly | the patient cancels partway through a paid monthly cycle | the cancellation takes effect at the end of that paid cycle |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual | the patient cancels | the cancellation takes effect the same day |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Member | no activity of any kind for 24 calendar months | the membership closes |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | activity on the membership within the last 24 calendar months | C3 does not close it |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual | no activity for more than 24 months | C3 does not apply: the period at this level is 0 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly, suspended | the reinstatement window ends without the fee being collected | the membership closes |

**Who confirms a closure request?** The patient confirms it themselves.
